LET US DO THE COOKING
City Center Catering offers a wide range of products and services to meet
your catering needs. Some of our most popular options include:
Appetizers and hors d’oeuvres, buffet style meals, plated dinners, desserts and
baked goods, beverage service, and professional event coordination
“City Center Catering made planning our wedding reception a breeze.”
- Brian and Sara K.
PRICING
At City Center Catering, we believe that great catering shouldn't break the
bank. We offer competitive pricing on all of our products and services, and we
are happy to work with you to create a customized package that fits your
budget.
MAKE IT PICTURE PERFECT
We can accommodate events of any size, from intimate dinners to large
corporate events. Our team will work with you to customize a menu that fits
your tastes and budget, and we are happy to accommodate any dietary
restrictions or special requests.

CITY CENTER CATERING
EXPERIENCE AND EXPERTISE
Our team of experienced chefs, servers, and event coordinators work
together seamlessly to ensure that your event is a success. We take pride in
using only the freshest ingredients and creating customized menus that suit
your specific tastes and dietary needs.
“They were professional, accommodating, and the food was fantastic. We will
definitely use them again for future events.” – John S
WHAT WE DO BEST
City Center Catering offers a wide range of products and services to meet
your catering needs. Some of our most popular options include:
• Appetizers and hors d'oeuvres
• Buffet-style meals
• Plated dinners
• Desserts and baked goods
• Beverage service
• Professional event coordination
OUR MISSION
At City Center Catering, our mission is to provide exceptional catering
services that exceed our clients' expectations. We believe that every event
should be an unforgettable experience, and we strive to create that
experience through delicious food, exceptional service, and attention to detail.
We are committed to sourcing the highest-quality ingredients, using
innovative techniques and presentation, and delivering unparalleled customer
service.
OUR GOAL IS TO MAKE YOUR EVENT
A SUCCESS, AND WE LOOK
FORWARD TO SERVING YOU.
